---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Sanson
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## Use case

Describe the problem you are trying to solve or the workflow you would like to support. What does Sanson currently make hard or impossible?

## Proposed solution

Optional. Outline how you imagine this could work — API shape, UI flow, configuration. Prototype links or screenshots welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they don't fit.

## Additional context

Links to relevant OGC specs, prior art in other tools, related issues, or sample data.

## Out of scope?

Please check the [Out of scope](../../SPECS.md#3-out-of-scope) section before opening — features like authentication, WMS/WFS, ORMs and Redis are explicitly not planned.
